title: Daredevil's Future After Born Again Cancellation Just Got the Answer Fans Wanted - NewsBreak
text:
By Devanshi Basu ,
23 minutes ago Photo Credit: Marvel Marvel fans have spent weeks worrying that the end of Daredevil: Born Again would mean the permanent end of Charlie Cox’s Matt Murdock in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. The actor has now addressed that fear, and his response should calm plenxty of nerves.
Charlie Cox doesn’t think Daredevil: Born Again will be the end of Matt Murdock At New York Comic-Con 2026, ScreenRant asked Cox whether Season 3 of Daredevil: Born Again would be his final one as the Devil of Hell’s Kitchen. Cox answered with cautious optimism. “Do I think we have seen Matt for the last time? I honestly don’t know, I’d hate to speculate, but I don’t think so,” he said. “I think there will be something; [it] might not be for a long time, but there are [ways] I think he will show up somehow, somewhere.”
That answer holds weight because Deadline confirmed last month that Daredevil: Born Again ends with Season 3. The season has finished filming and lands on Disney+ in 2027. Moreover, the cancellation stings for a second time. Netflix dropped the original Daredevil after three seasons in 2018, which sparked the “Save Daredevil” campaign. Cox nodded to that history during the panel, joking that the movement will likely return. “All I’ll say is, I imagine the ‘Save Daredevil’ campaign will be gearing up for round two,” he said. “Listen, we don’t want to invite the wrath of the ‘Save Daredevil’ people.”
However, the upcoming season also features a Defenders reunion. Krysten Ritter returns as Jessica Jones, Mike Colter as Luke Cage, and Finn Jones as Danny Rand, joining Vincent D’Onofrio, Deborah Ann Woll, Elden Henson, and Wilson Bethel. Now, Cox’s comments leave the door open.
Matt Murdock may step away for a while, but the actor clearly believes another appearance will come. For a hero cancelled twice, that’s the answer fans wanted.
